targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(toDateTime(ts)) AS time, count()/60.0 AS "req/s" FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' AND host LIKE '${host_filter}' AND status >= ${min_status} GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(toDateTime(ts)) AS time, sni AS series, count() AS sess FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='stream' AND sni LIKE '${host_filter}' GROUP BY time, sni ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(toDateTime(ts)) AS time, multiIf(status BETWEEN 200 AND 299,'2xx', status BETWEEN 300 AND 399,'3xx', status BETWEEN 400 AND 499,'4xx', status BETWEEN 500 AND 599,'5xx','other') AS class, count() AS c FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' AND host LIKE '${host_filter}' GROUP BY time, class ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(toDateTime(ts)) AS time, quantile(0.50)(req_time) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(req_time) AS p95, quantile(0.99)(req_time) AS p99 FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' AND host LIKE '${host_filter}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT host, count() AS reqs, formatReadableSize(sum(size)) AS bytes, round(quantile(0.95)(req_time),3) AS p95s FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' AND host LIKE '${host_filter}' GROUP BY host ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT sni, count() AS sess, formatReadableSize(sum(size)) AS sent, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_recv)) AS recv, round(avg(session_time),1) AS avg_s FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='stream' AND sni LIKE '${host_filter}' GROUP BY sni ORDER BY sess DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT backend, count() AS reqs, formatReadableSize(sum(size)) AS bytes, round(quantile(0.95)(req_time),3) AS p95s FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' AND host LIKE '${host_filter}' GROUP BY backend ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT substring(uri,1,120) AS uri, count() AS reqs, anyLast(host) AS sample_host, anyLast(status) AS last_status FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' AND host LIKE '${host_filter}' GROUP BY uri ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT if(cf_ip != '' AND cf_ip != '-', cf_ip, if(xff != '' AND xff != '-', splitByChar(',', xff)[1], client)) AS real_ip, count() AS reqs, uniq(host) AS hosts, uniq(uri) AS uniq_uri, anyLast(ua) AS sample_ua FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' GROUP BY real_ip ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Tentativas de exploit (URIs/UA suspeitos)
panels.description: Heurística: filtra URIs com padrões típicos de scan/RCE (wget, eval, ../, .env, /admin, /phpunit, /device.rsp, etc) e UAs vazios/cmd. Cada linha é um candidato a investigar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(ts) AS time, if(cf_ip != '' AND cf_ip != '-', cf_ip, client) AS real_ip, host, method, status, substring(uri,1,200) AS uri_excerpt, substring(ua,1,80) AS ua_excerpt FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' AND ( match(uri,'(?i)(wget|curl |/bin/|;rm |chmod |\\.\\./|\\.env|/wp-(admin|login)|/phpmyadmin|/phpunit|/eval|/cgi-bin|/console|/shell|/setup\\.cgi|device\\.rsp|\\.git/|/actuator|/api/v1/version|/api/jsonws|/jenkins|/solr|/druid|/_ignition|/HNAP1)') OR match(ua,'(?i)(zgrab|nuclei|masscan|nmap|sqlmap|nikto|dirbuster|wpscan|gobuster|fuzz|hydra)') OR ua='' OR ua='-' ) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT substring(ua,1,120) AS ua, count() AS reqs, uniq(host) AS hosts, uniq(if(cf_ip != '' AND cf_ip != '-', cf_ip, client)) AS uniq_ips FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' GROUP BY ua ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT toDateTime(ts) AS time, host, status, backend, substring(uri,1,80) AS uri, round(req_time,3) AS rt FROM netmon.nginx_access WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(ts)) AND src='http' AND status >= 500 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100
